Question: What were our sales last month?
text:
```sql
SELECT SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_sales_last_month
FROM orders o
JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= date('now','-1 month','start of month')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < date('now','start of month');
```
This query sums all payment values for orders whose purchase date falls within the month preceding the current month.

Simpler: between date('now','-1 month','start of month') and date('now','-1 month','+1 month','-1 day'). Use order_purchase_timestamp column.
